text: My old laptop suddenly refused to charge last week. Instead of tossing it or buying a replacement, I opened the chassis and discovered a single blown capacitor on the charging board. I ordered a five-dollar part, soldered it in, and now the machine is running like new. This is why I advocate for repairable hardware. There is a deep, quiet satisfaction in rescuing a piece of technology from a landfill rather than contributing to the global e-waste crisis.
